complexity.notes: Decode is quadratic: each iteration re-slices the remaining string (s = s[...:]), copying O(remaining) characters per string, so total work is O(total_chars * num_strings). Using an index pointer instead of re-slicing would make it O(n) overall. Minor style point: the length prefix is parsed twice (int(s[0:a])); computing it once would be cleaner.
complexity.summary: Encodes each string as '<length>|<content>' concatenated together; decode repeatedly reads the length prefix up to the '|' delimiter, extracts that many characters, and slices off the consumed prefix.
